note: Exact memo hits on supported Linux/macOS filesystems may reuse content-bound native identity/size/mtime/change-time proofs instead of rereading bytes. Windows always reads and hashes content; unsupported, racy, changed or missing files also take strict verification. Proof-cache capacity participates in the exact-memo census and idle eviction. Candidate sets, evidence, ordering, paging and complete public replies remain unchanged; the frozen 108-query corpus and parity fixtures are not modified.
